prompt: make the title a flickering pink neon sign with a wave running through it, and make the buttons wobble like jelly when i hover them

messages.text: make the title a flickering pink neon sign with a wave running through it, and make the buttons wobble like jelly when i hover them

ran ls sites/timsrobot.com 2>/dev/null; trif run 'const h=document.querySelector("main h1"); return {html:h.outerHTML.slice(0,300), font:getComputedStyle(h).font}'; trif sweep --selector 'button, .btn, [role=button]'

The title is one plain-text h1, and there are two buttons. Two mods, then: I'll split the title into letters for the wave (keeping each word together, so it only wraps between words) and give it a warm-up flicker before it lights; the buttons get a squash-and-stretch wobble.
ran trif new timsrobot.com neon && trif new timsrobot.com jelly

ran trif check timsrobot.com/neon && trif check timsrobot.com/jelly && trif reload && trif run 'const h=document.querySelector("main h1"); return {c:getComputedStyle(h).color, a:getComputedStyle(h).animationName}'

ran trif run 'const b=document.querySelector(".btn"); b.style.animation="jb-jelly 0.7s ease-out both"; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,170)); const t=getComputedStyle(b).transform; b.style.animation=""; return t'; trif screenshot -o wave.png
Lit, waving and wobbling. The flicker goes by too fast to read, so I'm stretching the warm-up a little.

Done: two new mods.

- **Neon Title:** "Tim's Robot Internet Fixer" starts out as dark pink glass, flickers on and off for a couple of seconds, then lights up for good. After that it hums, the "o" in "Robot" sputters now and then like a faulty tube, and a wave rolls through the letters, left to right.
- **Jelly Buttons:** hover over "Get it" or "GitHub" and the button squashes, stretches and settles back, like jelly.

**What I checked:** after a reload the title started unlit and finished lit, the letter heights showed the wave travelling across it, and running the wobble on "Get it" squashed it as expected. No errors. If your system is set to reduce motion, the title just glows and the buttons keep still.

To undo either one, switch it off in the side panel, or ask me to.
